effort_mechanism: CLI flag `--effort <low|medium|high|xhigh|max>` on `claude -p`. VERIFICATION DEVIATION: the acceptance test in README §4.5 (thinking-token counts differing ~10x) could NOT be executed as written — thinking content blocks are emitted but redacted to empty strings in BOTH the stream-json stdout and the persisted transcript at ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<session>.jsonl, so thinking tokens are not measurable by this harness. Substituted instrument, operator-approved 2026-07-24: total output_tokens from the stream-json `result` event, with visible text output held approximately constant by the prompt. Evidence in results/preflight/: (a) bounded prompt, 3 repeats each, claude-opus-5 low = 586/624/581 out vs xhigh = 961/942/1065 out, visible text 1.5-1.9k chars in both arms — distributions non-overlapping, direction deterministic; (b) unbounded hard-reasoning prompt, single shot: opus low 9,415 -> xhigh 24,997 out (145s -> 375s), fable low 4,606 -> xhigh 13,241 out (81s -> 206s). NEGATIVE CONTROL WORTH KNOWING: on a prompt whose output was hard-capped (`exactly three bullets, max 15 words`), opus showed NO effort response at all (low 104 / medium 96 / high 101 / xhigh 104 / max 112 out) while fable did (low 130 vs xhigh 761) — effort is suppressed by tight output constraints on opus. The benchmark briefs are unbounded agentic tasks, so this control does not apply to them, but it is a real threat-to-validity to carry into RESULT.md.
